📰 General

Chelsea Sacks Manager Liam Rosenior Following String of Premier League Losses •

Chelsea Football Club has terminated the contract of manager Liam Rosenior, who had been in the role since January. Rosenior, 41, was appointed with a contract extending until June 2032. The decision follows a series of five consecutive defeats in the Premier League. The club cited the recent poor performance as the reason for the immediate dismissal. Further details regarding the club’s succession plan are currently unavailable.

🌍 World

Cedarburg Couple Escapes Deadly Shooting at Iconic Teotihuacan Pyramids •

A Cedarburg couple, Jake and Tami Struck, have returned safely after surviving a shooting at the Teotihuacan Pyramids in Mexico. The incident occurred on Monday, resulting in one fatality and at least thirteen injuries among tourists and visitors. Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the shooting at the ancient archaeological site. The Strucks were among the individuals present at the time of the attack.

🦅 US

Artemis II Heat Shield Exceeds Expectations, Delivering Successful Re-Entry •

NASA’s Artemis II heat shield successfully protected the Orion capsule during its re-entry into Earth’s atmosphere. Initial reports confirm the shield performed as anticipated, mitigating extreme temperatures generated by atmospheric friction. The mission’s April 1 launch had preceded significant debate regarding the shield’s design and effectiveness. Data collected during re-entry supports NASA’s assessment of the heat shield’s robust performance.

💰 Business

Warsh’s Inflation Preference Sparks Concerns About Fed Strategy •

Kevin Warsh, President Trump’s nominee for Federal Reserve chair, has advocated for a shift in the Fed’s inflation measurement strategy, specifically suggesting a focus on the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index. Bank of America economist Aditya Bhave cautioned that this change could lead to a misleading picture of inflation. The PCE index, which includes measures of inflation expectations, is considered by some to be a more accurate reflection of underlying price pressures than the Consumer Price Index (CPI). This proposal has raised questions about the Fed’s ability to effectively manage inflation if it adopts a different measurement approach.

💻 Technology

Google Teases Gemini-Powered Siri Upgrade Following Apple Intelligence Reveal •

During Google’s Cloud Next ’26 keynote, Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian showcased the company’s Apple Foundation Model and Apple Intelligence. The presentation highlighted a forthcoming upgrade to Siri, powered by Google’s Gemini AI model. Kurian emphasized the integration of Google’s AI capabilities with Apple’s existing intelligence features. This development suggests a potential competitive shift in the voice assistant market.

🎭 Entertainment

Zendaya Dominates Met Gala, Showcasing Stunning Custom Valentino Gown •

Zendaya attended the 2024 Met Gala in a breathtaking custom Valentino gown designed by Pierpaolo Piccioli. The dress featured a dramatic, floor-length silhouette with intricate embellishments and a deep V-neckline. She was joined by her partner, Tom Holland, who sported a tailored black suit. The event, themed "Sleeping Beauties: Reawakening Fashion," drew celebrities from across the entertainment industry.

🏅 Sports

Alabama Basketball Coach Paige Adams Indicted on 32 Sex Crime Charges •

Paige Adams, a former coach for the Alabama girls’ high school basketball team, has been indicted on 32 counts of deviant sexual intercourse with a student. The charges stem from allegations involving a student athlete under her supervision. Authorities allege Adams engaged in inappropriate conduct with the student, leading to the criminal charges. The investigation is ongoing, and Adams has been formally charged with the offenses.

🔬 Science

Scientists Suggest Vital Energy Flow, Not Genes or Diet, Drives Human Health •

Researchers, led by Martin Picard, propose that the fundamental difference between a living and a deceased human body lies in the presence of energy. This concept posits that physical structures like DNA, proteins, and organs are maintained by a continuous flow of energy. Picard’s research focuses on this energetic aspect as a key factor in overall health and bodily function. The study highlights a shift in understanding health, moving beyond traditional genetic and dietary influences.

🩺 Health

New Study Links Gut Bacteria to Increased Risk of Alzheimer’s Disease •

Researchers at the University of Minnesota have identified a specific gut bacteria composition that correlates with an elevated risk of developing Alzheimer’s disease. The study, published in Alzheimer’s & Dementia, analyzed the gut microbiome of over 150 individuals, comparing those with and without the disease. Participants with a higher abundance of Desulfovibrio bacteria exhibited a significantly increased risk of cognitive decline. Scientists believe this bacteria produces compounds that may contribute to inflammation and neuronal damage within the brain.
